provenance.density: Mass-weighted CIC deposition of simulation stellar particles with authored offline Gaussian smoothing.

photo.credit: CTIO/NOIRLab/NSF/AURA/SMASH/D. Nidever (Montana State University) Acknowledgment: Image processing: Travis Rector (University of Alaska Anchorage), Mahdi Zamani & Davide de Martin

alignment.method: Authored central-bar alignment in the XZ simulation projection; a rigid −34° rotation, with no scaling or coordinate warp.
alignment.photoScale: Angular WCS extent at the reference 49.59 kpc distance, evaluated on the tangent plane.
alignment.displayScope: Photographed central region. The finite core grid excludes outer simulation tidal tails; full imported particles are preserved.
alignment.registration: Photo center is matched to the simulated central bar, not an astrometric identity between simulation and observed stars.

display.color: Photographic brightness and color distributed through the simulated conditional depth profile. Authored display emissivity, not measured gas, dust or stellar population synthesis.
display.dust: No dust or extinction is encoded; alpha is stellar-density support.
display.brightness: Photographic display brightness constrained along the reference projection; not calibrated photometry.

approximation.method: Filtered scalar fields; decoded after filtering; integrated RGB emission; exponential shared opacity with optical RGB ratios in ordinary alpha.
limitations: Shared-opacity display emission preserves column-constant chromaticity before RGBA8 quantization; varying chromaticity remains a slab approximation. Extinction is unsupported.
Finite slices and axis handoffs approximate a continuous field; angle-dependent opacity and sampling differences remain.
No runtime ray integration, near-field noise or global HDR display pass.
